project_name: Quantum Lab: From Planck to Chips
description: A refined, playful-yet-mature retro-futuristic pixel-inspired UI crafted for university physics & electrical engineering students. It blends precise high-tech gridlines, subtle glowing CRT/circuit pixel motifs, crisp monospace and geometric typography with rich dark obsidian, quantum cyan, semiconductor neon amber, and deep violet surfaces.

rules.pixel_font_usage: Use 'Press Start 2P' sparingly ONLY for small badges, XP counts, LEVEL tags, chapter numbers, and retro-button labels (font size 10px-12px, tracking-widest). Never use for body paragraphs or long descriptions to maintain academic readability.
rules.headings: Space Grotesk with font-bold / font-black and tracking-tight for titles, modal headers, and chapter names.
rules.body: JetBrains Mono with leading-relaxed (15px desktop, 14px mobile) for lesson copy, explanations, equations, and code/formulas.

entry_surfaces./: Retro-cybernetic title screen: Pixel logo badge + Glowing particle grid background + Start Adventure / Continue CTA stack + Language & Sound quick-toggles
entry_surfaces./map: Interactive 13-node circuit path map: Header HUD (XP, Badge, Lang Toggle) + Scrollable vertical/horizontal node trajectory with status badges (Locked, In-Progress, Completed)
entry_surfaces./chapter/:id: Quantum workspace split: Top Navigation & HUD + Left Lesson/Formula panel with KaTeX + Right Interactive Simulation canvas area + 'Ask Why' Drawer & 'Next' Action bar
entry_surfaces./quiz/:id: Tactical assessment console: 5-question multi-choice stepper with terminal-style timer, feedback score matrix, and XP reward animations
entry_surfaces./journal: Lab Notebook grid: Categorized discovery cards (Planck constant, Wave-Particle, Bandgap, MOSFET, FinFET) with pixel stamp icons and unlocked formulas
entry_surfaces./settings: Clean engineering control panel: Language toggle (ID / EN), Sound FX toggle, Progress Reset modal, and Dark Mode theme lock

visual_enhancers.pixel_borders: 2px solid border with subtle step corners (box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #00F5D4 or 3px 3px 0px #1E293B for neo-pixel depth)
visual_enhancers.scanline_effect: Optional subtle background scanline overlay (linear-gradient(rgba(18, 16, 16, 0) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 50%)) with 4px grid
visual_enhancers.circuit_lines: Subtle SVG quantum orbit / circuit trace overlays in header and map path
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,245,212,0.4)] on active buttons, chapter nodes, and XP badges

chapters_blueprint.title_en: MOSFET Transistor: The Modern Electronic Valve
FinFET, GAA & The 2nm Chip Quantum Boundary

elements: XP Counter with animated spark (+50 XP)
13 progressive nodes connected by glowing pixel circuit trace
4 Era Segment Headers (Quantum Birth, Wave Mechanics, Solid-State Physics, Nanometer Chip Design)
Node cards displaying chapter title, concept badge, KaTeX preview snippet, locked/unlocked state, and completion star rating
Left/Top: Lesson Content Panel with rich KaTeX math render, intuitive concept breakdown, and 'Key Takeaway' box
Right/Bottom: Interactive Simulation Canvas Stage (placeholder simulation sandbox ready for wave, particle, potential well, and transistor toggles)
Bottom action bar: 'Ask Why / Tanya Mengapa' expandable drawer, 'Take Quiz' CTA, and 'Next Chapter' button
Streak bonus calculation and XP award popups
Searchable discovery log with formula cheatsheets and unlocked concept cards

motion.page_transitions: opacity and scale from 0.98 to 1 with 0.2s ease-out
motion.xp_gain_animation: spring scale up to 1.15 then settle with golden particle burst
motion.reduced_motion: Wrap animations with conditional prefers-reduced-motion check or use opacity-only transitions.

accessibility.contrast_check: All text tokens exceed WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio against dark background (#0B0F17 / #111827).
accessibility.data_test_ids: All interactive elements (buttons, language toggles, chapter nodes, quiz options, tabs, modal triggers) MUST carry explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='lang-toggle-btn', data-testid='chapter-node-1', data-testid='start-adventure-btn').
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full focus-visible styling with 2px cyan ring (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#00F5D4]).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Verify Zustand store at frontend/src/store/gameStore.ts holding: language ('id'|'en'), currentChapter (1..13), unlockedChapters (number[]), completedChapters (number[]), xp (number), badges (Badge[]), journalEntries (JournalEntry[]), and soundEnabled (boolean). Persist with zustand/middleware persist to localStorage.
2. Implement responsive mobile-first UI: On mobile screens, ChapterWorkspace stacks lesson vertically above simulation canvas, and bottom HUD stays pinned. Map view scrolls comfortably on touch.
3. Use KaTeX via 'katex' / 'react-katex' for crisp mathematical formula rendering (E=hf, Schrödinger equation, de Broglie relation, tunneling probability).
4. Install any lightweight dependencies needed (e.g. katex @types/katex zustand lucide-react canvas-confetti) in frontend.
5. Ensure dark mode is active by default in index.html class='dark' and Tailwind v4 theme in frontend/src/index.css.

6. Build rich bilingual dictionaries for Indonesian and English in frontend/src/i18n/ so all 13 chapter titles, concepts, navigation items, quiz prompts, and settings labels translate seamlessly with instant toggle.

7. Add delightful pixel-art button styles: border-2 border-cyan-400 bg-slate-900 shadow-[3px_3px_0px_#00F5D4] hover:shadow-[1px_1px_0px_#00F5D4] hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:translate-y-[2px] transition-all.
